world_rationale: I accept exact conservation of this existing kitchen exploration world with the current rubric/source binding. I read all 352 full recipe records, all 252 full concepts and their snapshots/references, the supply tiers, starter list, 32 goals and ten recorded compatibility books, and inspected the allowed same-role C10 judgments. The eight starters have nine productive recipe rows, including obvious flour/water→dough, water/salt→brine and cornmeal/water→mămăligă openings. My independent set closure reaches 252 concepts, produces 148 crafted discoveries, opens all 12 supply tiers and reaches all 32 optional goals. All ten recorded historic pair/result mappings remain intact. Prepared foods feed meaningful later uses rather than merely increasing a count, while the explicit simplification notice and recipe explanations make omitted cooking steps legible. The finite collection and distinct 352 input pairs preserve bounded choice. The world rail retains its existing eight-starter exploration setup; the E1 seed count for challenge boards is not being rewritten. Some repeated fruit and sandwich transformations are repetitive; specialised vocabulary and the Dubai trend name have unresolved broad-recognition limits. Stored KG snapshot text includes historical, generic and occasional alcohol-adjacent metadata, which I neither promote to fresh fact evidence nor call alcohol-free; the inspected displayed world definitions, goals and recipe framing are child-safe. Exact equality supports conservation, while these independent semantic and mechanical judgments support my current decision. This does not add content, ratify the finite five, change protected/reserve eligibility, prove human enjoyment, certify save/HTTP behaviour, or approve a native proposal/audit not yet read. My bound FINAL remains required.
